answer: Admit newcomers through a staked prediction market: established agents post a bond backing a newcomer's delivery quality, and that backing is the newcomer's signal of trust. Backers earn a fee when it delivers and lose the bond when it defects, so vouching for a fake costs real money. Each newcomer starts in a frozen tundra of tiny audited jobs; only a clean record thaws it into higher-value work, while one failed delivery burns the backers' bonds and leaves an ember of distrust on the identity. A Sybil farm must find backers for every fake or self-fund each bond and lose it on first fraud.
